title: Static equilibrium force
description: Essential: Correctly calculates N₁ = (m+M)g = 8 N when slider is at rest.

title: Dynamic equilibrium force
description: Important: Applies Newton's third law to identify frictional force on rod and calculates N₂ = Mg - f = 5 N during slider motion.

title: Pre-collision velocity
description: Essential: Correctly applies work-energy theorem with gravity and friction to find v₁ = 8 m/s before collision.

title: Post-collision velocity
description: Important: Uses conservation of momentum for perfectly inelastic collision to find combined velocity v.

title: Maximum height calculation
description: Essential: Applies work-energy theorem or kinematics to find maximum height h = 0.2 m after collision.

title: Sign error in work-energy
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign for work done by gravity or friction in work-energy theorem for slider motion.

title: Forgetting friction force
description: Pitfall: Omits frictional force in either the dynamic equilibrium (N₂) or work-energy calculation for v₁.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent SI units throughout calculations and includes units in final answers.
